translations.web: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.
translations.bsb: I will be glad and rejoice in Your loving devotion, for You have seen my affliction; You have known the anguish of my soul.
translations.kjv: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;
